canonicalRequirements.statement: Bind the Owner-ratified GATE25 canonical mandate instrument by its exact SHA-256 0aefedc757e2ba749ebd25a2cd40dc2070fafb04f3ac8f7b194c08d2b513c618 (88712 bytes). The in-place Owner-ratified source bytes remain 42f1cc146e413fa450a50e8f26a9be7a59d30e66062bdc3538c93e1812e25341 / 75816. Owner decision OWNER_RATIFY_GATE25_CANONICAL_MANDATE_R0_R1. The mandate freezes HISTORICAL ANALOGUE ENGINE design scope only and confers no execution, START, BUILD, observation-admission, ledger, commit or push authority.

This revision remains PRESTART ONLY. startAuthorized=false. ratificationIsNotStart=true. GATE25 remains NOT_STARTED. It authorizes no START, no BUILD, no analogue computation and no lifecycle transition. DatasetId_observation admission is authorized only for the exact bounded GATE25 historical scope in G25-PRESTART-05; every broader admission remains forbidden.
Reuse the GATE24 terminal dependency proof COMPLETE_CONFIRMED, bound by exact SHA-256. GATE24 is not re-audited and not reopened by this candidate.
OD-1, OD-2, OD-3, OD-4 and OD-5 remain CLOSED and unchanged. This revision does not reopen them and does not rewrite their substance.

OD-4 remains the unchanged P3H pinset of 793 VERSION_CACHED SnapshotDatasetManifestV1 keys plus 9 documented exclusions. observationAdmissionAuthorized=true only for DatasetId_observation under the exact bounded GATE25 historical scope: datasetIdentity sha256:cc7bb76f37a97a5673a32c5a8f357088ee94230fefcbef1c19ad16227476488e, admittedKeyDigest 9fdc19bff5de2769c32cdb7fde866e83adb120ec16736c8cabc1b1851f98ef85, exclusionDigest 7eca4720595e05aaeaf3d8e35f40ada3efb41ab4d7a58147670119304c0c2e7d, and historical observation window 2018-01-02 through 2026-09-04 inclusive. Global identity policy is unchanged: earliestAdmissibleSession=2026-05-04, aliasBackdating=FORBIDDEN, retroactive2026IdentityApplication=FORBIDDEN, identityResolutionRule=RESOLVE_AT_EACH_HISTORICAL_SESSION_DATE. Pre-2026-05-04 observations are admitted only through this bounded GATE25 historical scope.

The eight mandate deferredToContract items remain deliberately unbound in this revision. A separately authorized later GATE25 contract succession is required to bind them before BUILD; R0002 binds none of them. GATE21, GATE22, GATE23 and GATE24 surfaces, P3H, P3G, the status ledger, ACTIVE_GATE, and the ratified mandate stay unmodified by this succession.
